# ADR-004: Canonicalize loop every 6 hours plus daily audit

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Date:** 2026-11-05

## Decision
A `canonicalize` job folds daily logs into the owner profile every 6 hours and emits a gap queue (what Jaari does not yet know). A daily audit checks memory consistency and reports drift.

## Alternatives rejected
Write-through profile updates on every turn (noisy, expensive); no curation (memory becomes a log).
